name: legacy-ledger-entry
workflow: enter approved entry legacy desktop app ledger
description: Enter one approved ledger entry into the Legacy Ledger desktop app, which has no API. Proves the pixel tier on a contained task. Guided mode: needs the model and the test app running.

steps.intent: Enter account {account}, amount {amount}, memo '{memo}' into Legacy Ledger and save it
steps.instructions: Take a screenshot. The window is titled 'Legacy Ledger - TEST'. Click the Account field and type {account}; click Amount and type {amount}; click Memo and type {memo}; click 'Save Entry'. Confirm the status line says the entry was saved.
